PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.PHASE_GATE: v2.6.3 is the current supported Linux/macOS release candidate after Phase-68; all indexed phases are done and release freshness requires a new tag at HEAD.
PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.SUMMARY: Synapse is ready for the v2.6.3 release line as a governed AI engineering toolkit with full RTK parity gates, GraphRAG/LSP improvements, strict MyGRACE traceability, zero canonical drift, and public installer truth aligned to Linux x86_64/aarch64 plus macOS x86_64/arm64 artifacts.

EVIDENCE.MYGRACE_DRIFT: 0 canonical drift across 98 code modules, graph shards, and verification shards after Phase-68 refresh.
EVIDENCE.LOCAL_CI_GATE: Release-candidate gates are run before publishing v2.6.3: cargo tests, release version/freshness guards, release/install smoke, RTK full release gate, MyGRACE verify/review, refresh, and status.
EVIDENCE.HOSTED_CI_GATE: Hosted CI must pass on pushed main and on the v2.6.3 tag before treating the supported GitHub release artifacts as final.
EVIDENCE.RELEASE_VERSION_TRUTH: Tags v2.6.0 and v2.6.1 are already published on older commits; the current release line therefore advances Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, install.sh, public docs, and release-smoke verification refs to v2.6.3.
EVIDENCE.MAIN_BRANCH_VERSION_TRUTH: Main must publish a fresh v2.6.3 tag at the release commit so release freshness guards do not confuse post-release commits with stale tags.
EVIDENCE.INSTALLER_TRUTH: The installer still prefers signed-off release artifacts plus SHA256SUMS verification. Source fallback is now explicit for supported hosts: SYN_INSTALL_SOURCE_REF for hosted fresh-install smoke, selected Git tag when available, and default main branch only during the pre-tag release-candidate window.
EVIDENCE.FRESH_INSTALL_TRUTH: Push CI fresh-install smoke uses raw.githubusercontent.com at the exact workflow commit plus SYN_INSTALL_SOURCE_REF, preventing a current-HEAD smoke job from silently installing an older release tag. Public install docs now target https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anyagixx/synapse/v2.6.3/install.sh.
EVIDENCE.PACKAGE_TRUTH: The Cargo package is synapse-agent to avoid the crates.io syn parser conflict; the public binary and library crate remain syn.
EVIDENCE.SECURITY_AUDIT_TRUTH: cargo audit --deny warnings passes for the release line with an explicit RUSTSEC-2024-0436 waiver for the transitive fastembed/tokenizers paste maintenance warning.
EVIDENCE.MCP_CLI_TRUTH: syn mcp is public stdio-only. verify_project/review_code and syn verify/review now expose profile-aware strictness without changing the strict CI default.
EVIDENCE.NO_ACTIVE_PHASE_TRUTH: docs/plan-index.xml now has ACTIVE_PHASE none after all phase shards are done; status and refresh preserve that state instead of reporting a completed phase as active.
EVIDENCE.DOC_TRUTH: Public README, INSTALL, COMMANDS, FAQ, QUICKSTART, WORKFLOW, and SUPPORT docs are guarded against ghost CLI commands, unsupported flags, unsupported installer URLs, obsolete release paths, unsupported Windows install claims, unmeasured token-savings percentages, and misleading privacy wording.
EVIDENCE.LICENSE_TRUTH: LICENSE now contains the full Apache License 2.0 text instead of a short placeholder.
EVIDENCE.SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTICS: install.sh --diagnose reports independent OS and architecture support status, supported Linux/macOS artifact mapping including macOS Intel, install directory status, tool availability, checksum verifier status, Windows packaging deferral, and SYN_INSTALL_DIR guidance.

RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_MACOS_INTEL_EMBEDDING_RUNTIME: macOS Intel prebuilt install is restored through an ort-load-dynamic build; optional local embeddings on Intel macOS require a compatible libonnxruntime.dylib via ORT_DYLIB_PATH, while default indexing/search remain lexical-safe.
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_WINDOWS_DEFERRED: Windows prebuilt install remains intentionally deferred and is not part of the first supported Linux/macOS public release scope.
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_EXTERNAL_ADOPTION_EVIDENCE: Real user feedback still needs to be collected across more Linux/macOS environments after the public release.
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_TEST_FILE_SIZE_TARGET: tests/docs_parity.rs and tests/integration_test.rs exceed the 500-line Phase-2 maintainability target while remaining under the hard 1300-line gate.

PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.NEXT_PHASE: Publish v2.6.3, wait for hosted main/tag release workflows, collect Linux/macOS user feedback, and defer Windows packaging to a later dedicated release line.
